title: Swedish-style seeded crispbread
summary: Thin, shattering sheets of whole sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, in the spirit of Swedish knäckebröd.
steps: Mix the seeds, flaxseed meal, almond flour, psyllium, salt and anise. Stir in the olive oil and boiling water and rest 10 minutes until thick.
Spread thinly and evenly between two sheets of parchment, about 3 mm (⅛ in), to fill a large baking sheet. Remove the top sheet.
Bake 20 minutes, then cut into 10 pieces with a pizza cutter and bake 35–40 minutes more, until dry, crisp and lightly golden.
Leave in the turned-off oven 30 minutes, then cool on a rack. Store airtight.
tips: Traditional knäckebröd is often flavoured with caraway or fennel seed if you have them.

origin.history: Knäckebröd, Swedish crispbread, has been baked in Sweden for centuries, traditionally from rye. It was made in large rounds with a hole in the middle so it could be threaded on poles under the ceiling and kept dry for months. This grain-free version keeps the thin, crackling texture but builds it from seeds.
